title: Keep common receiver calibration errors from becoming a background-sized floor
statement: Under x_l=alpha h_zeta_l+beta conjugate(h_zeta_l)+b+e_l with common alpha,beta,b,0<gL<=|alpha|<=gU,|beta|<=bmax and load error d_z within rmax<1,the clipped estimate obeys |p_tilde-q|<=B+Theta q,q=|alpha|p. If Theta<1,the stated divided interval encloses p even for weak targets.

requires: Acquired shared coefficient/stability bounds across all three loads
Bounded unshared error epsilon and load errors;gL>0,Theta<1
provides: Common offset cancellation and relative calibration inflation;actual final-load absorption factors
assumptions: Do not cap the scaled magnitude q at one before inversion
Unknown common phase is harmless;load-dependent phase is outside the common model
Failed qualifications retain a sound unresolved interval;an empty interval is an explicit inconsistency
costs: Charge all raw powers,reference/signal photons,combiner loss,calibration,mask writes,load switching,settling and reset;no free parameter,clock or arbitrarily strong local oscillator.
contract.units: Dimensionless power per incident feed-power unit;field amplitude is its square root. r,z,s are complex reflection amplitudes;R is reference amplitude. Physical photon/time calibration remains an acquired input.
contract.obstruction: Finite fits do not prove future commonality;more photons do not remove unshared drift or an uncalibrated load scale.
